newsitem.title: PERU: Lima offers $250 million road works contract.
newsitem.headline: Lima offers $250 million road works contract.

text.p: The municipality of Lima invited companies Thursday to compete for a three-year highway construction contract requiring an approximately $250 million investment.
Various U.S. and Spanish companies were already interested, said planning official Luis Consiglieri, without giving more details of those firms.
He added that the company which wins the contracts will be granted a 30-year toll concession on the new routes to recover the cost of their investment and make a profit.
The roads are due to be built in an effort to ease traffic congestion in this city of seven million inhabitants.
